lines.zh: 我侧着身子滑过暖水，刺先到，身子后到。
lines.en: I glide through warm water sideways; the spines arrive before I do.

lines.zh: 纺锤一样的身体一转，就在珊瑚上绕了半圈。
lines.en: My spindle body turns once and loops halfway around the coral.

lines.zh: 每划一下，两侧的刺都跟着晃。
lines.en: Every stroke sets the spines along both flanks swaying.

lines.zh: 我贴着暖水海底走，沙子从刺缝里漏过去。
lines.en: I skim the warm seabed and let sand slip between my spines.

lines.zh: 别看我小，我游起来像被拧紧的线轴。
lines.en: Small as I am, I swim like a tightened spool of thread.

lines.zh: 三根刺在左，三根在右，正好替我掌舵。
lines.en: Three spines left, three right, and they steer me perfectly.

lines.zh: 我从海草间穿过去，一根都没碰到。
lines.en: I thread between the seagrass without touching a single blade.

lines.zh: 暖流推着我走，我只要把尖的那头朝前。
lines.en: The warm current carries me; I keep the pointed end forward.

lines.zh: 我绕开那块石头，撞上去会先扎到自己。
lines.en: I swim around that rock; hitting it would sting me first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢巡这片浅湾，水一年到头都是温的。
lines.en: I patrol this shallow bay slowly; its water stays warm all year.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我整个身子像被甩出去的针。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and my body flies out like a thrown needle.

lines.zh: 我游得不高，头顶两格就是水面。
lines.en: I keep low; the surface is only two blocks above me.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的影子晃，我跟着晃，谁也分不清谁。
lines.en: Coral shadows sway, and I sway along, indistinguishable.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩缝走，那里最暖，也最不容易被撞。
lines.en: I follow the rock crevices, warmest and least likely to be bumped.

lines.zh: 暖流拐了个弯，我跟着拐。
lines.en: The warm current bends, and I bend with it.

lines.zh: 我贴着珊瑚脚游，那里水最稳。
lines.en: I swim along the coral's foot, where the water is steadiest.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，刺全朝外，像不欢迎人的花。
lines.en: I hang in the water, all spines out, a flower that welcomes no one.

lines.zh: 五点的血，够我安静地活很久。
lines.en: Five points of health is enough for a long quiet life.

lines.zh: 我数了数身上的刺，还是六根，一根没少。
lines.en: I count my spines: still six, not one missing.

lines.zh: 水从鳃里出去，带一点苦味。
lines.en: Water leaves my gills with a faint bitter taste.

lines.zh: 我把尖头对着洞口，剩下的时间发呆。
lines.en: I aim my pointed end at the opening and daydream.

lines.zh: 有鱼靠太近，我不动，它自己会撞上来。
lines.en: If a fish comes close, I hold still and let it bump me.

lines.zh: 暖水让我犯困，可我不敢真的睡着。
lines.en: Warm water makes me drowsy, but I never quite dare to sleep.

lines.zh: 我身上的毒不主动放，是被撞了才漏出去。
lines.en: My poison does not leak on purpose; it spills when something hits me.

lines.zh: 沙地上有一圈圈波纹，是我刚才转的。
lines.en: Rings ripple the sand where I turned a moment ago.

lines.zh: 远处鲸叫传来，那声音在水里拐了好几个弯。
lines.en: A whale calls far off, its voice bending through the water.

lines.zh: 我把身子横过来，让两边都晒一点光。
lines.en: I turn broadside so both flanks catch a little light.

lines.zh: 这里没有天敌，只有不会看路的过客。
lines.en: No predators here, only passersby who do not watch where they swim.

lines.zh: 刺尖上有一点白，那不是光，是毒。
lines.en: The white on my spine tips is not light; it is venom.

lines.zh: 我不追谁，也不逃谁，我只是待在这儿。
lines.en: I chase no one and flee no one; I simply stay here.

lines.zh: 你站在岸边看我，我知道你在想能不能吃。
lines.en: You watch from shore; I know you wonder if I am edible.

lines.zh: 你靠这么近，是没看见我两侧的刺吗。
lines.en: So close already — did you miss the spines on both my sides?

lines.zh: 你的手伸进水里，我的刺先竖起来了。
lines.en: Your hand enters the water, and my spines raise first.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，因为你的影子挡住了暖流。
lines.en: I stare at you because your shadow blocks the warm current.

lines.zh: 你的靴子在水里晃，晃得我有点想撞。
lines.en: Your boots sway in the water, and they make me want to bump them.

lines.zh: 我认识你这种眼神，捞鱼的人都是这样看的。
lines.en: I know that look; everyone who nets fish wears it.

lines.zh: 别用手指点我，我的反击不需要瞄准。
lines.en: Do not point at me; my retaliation needs no aim.

lines.zh: 我歪过头，让你看清我身上有几根刺。
lines.en: I tilt so you can count exactly how many spines I carry.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，水纹告诉我你怕了。
lines.en: You step back half a pace, and the ripples tell me you are afraid.

lines.zh: 你潜水下来时，我已把尖头对准你的膝盖。
lines.en: When you dive down, my pointed end is already level with your knee.

lines.zh: 你砍在我的刺上，海水一下变苦了。
lines.en: You strike my spines, and the seawater turns bitter.

lines.zh: 我流血很少，五点血经不起你两下。
lines.en: I bleed little; five points will not survive two of your blows.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我会缩成一团，刺全朝外。
lines.en: In pain I curl into a ball with every spine facing out.

lines.zh: 你的刀口很整齐，我的刺口不是。
lines.en: Your cut is clean; the wounds my spines leave are not.

lines.zh: 我往珊瑚缝里钻，那里你够不到。
lines.en: I squeeze into a coral crevice where you cannot reach.

lines.zh: 别以为我快死了，我死前还会扎你一次。
lines.en: Do not assume I am finished; I will sting you once before I die.

lines.zh: 我掉的那点血，让周围的水都腥了。
lines.en: The little blood I lose turns the nearby water metallic.

lines.zh: 这一下没扎到要害，我还能游。
lines.en: That blow missed anything vital; I can still swim.

lines.zh: 我身上少了一根刺，断口还在抽。
lines.en: One spine is gone, and the stump still twitches.

lines.zh: 你打我之前，最好想清楚那十秒。
lines.en: Before you hit me again, think hard about those ten seconds.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎屑落下来，我绕了三圈才敢靠近。
lines.en: Your crumbs drift down; I circle three times before daring to approach.

lines.zh: 那点吃的就悬在我刺够不到的地方。
lines.en: That morsel hangs just beyond where my spines can reach.

lines.zh: 我饿了，可我不想为一口吃的挨一下。
lines.en: I am hungry, but not enough to take a hit for one bite.

lines.zh: 你把手放低一点，我就再往前游一格。
lines.en: Lower your hand a little, and I will swim one more block closer.

lines.zh: 我闻到腥味，也闻到铁味，两样都在你手上。
lines.en: I smell fish and I smell iron, both on your hands.

lines.zh: 我张嘴接住一小块，刺还是朝着你的。
lines.en: I open my mouth for a small piece, spines still aimed at you.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我就记住你的手，不记住你的脸。
lines.en: Feed me and I will remember your hand, not your face.

lines.zh: 这点食物不够我长一根新刺。
lines.en: This much food will not grow me one new spine.

lines.zh: 我凑近了，但别忘了我是怎么自卫的。
lines.en: I come closer, but do not forget how I defend myself.

lines.zh: 你把鱼食丢在水面，我等它自己沉下来。
lines.en: You drop food at the surface; I wait for it to sink.

lines.zh: 你撞上来了，接下来十秒你会一直难受。
lines.en: You hit me, and for the next ten seconds you will keep suffering.

lines.zh: 不是我要扎你，是你自己撞进刺里的。
lines.en: I did not sting you; you swam into the spines yourself.

lines.zh: 我的毒已经进了你的血，慢慢数着吧。
lines.en: My venom is in your blood now; count the seconds slowly.

lines.zh: 你退开也没用，毒不跟着你走。
lines.en: Backing off will not help; the poison does not follow you out.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，把另一侧的刺也送给你。
lines.en: I roll over and offer you the spines on my other side too.

lines.zh: 这一下是碰撞，不是攻击，我不需要瞄准。
lines.en: That was a collision, not an attack; I never had to aim.

lines.zh: 你被扎的地方会发热，然后你会开始怀疑水。
lines.en: The spot will burn, and then you will start distrusting the water.

lines.zh: 我小小的，可我身上有六根会记仇的刺。
lines.en: I am small, but I carry six spines that hold grudges.

lines.zh: 你踩到我了，水底这么宽，你偏偏踩到我。
lines.en: You stepped on me; the seabed is wide and you found me anyway.

lines.zh: 别揉，揉只会让毒走得更快。
lines.en: Do not rub it; rubbing only spreads the venom faster.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，刺都收着，这是很少见的事。
lines.en: We swim side by side with spines lowered, which is rare for us.

lines.zh: 她绕着我转，我数她的刺，一根也不少。
lines.en: She circles me; I count her spines and find none missing.

lines.zh: 暖水里我们贴得很近，却谁也没扎到谁。
lines.en: We press close in the warm water without stinging each other.

lines.zh: 我把最尖的那面朝外，护着她往深处去。
lines.en: I face my sharpest side outward and guard her toward deeper water.

lines.zh: 我们的卵会沉在珊瑚脚边，那儿最暖。
lines.en: Our eggs will settle at the coral's foot, where it is warmest.

lines.zh: 她身上有和我一样的苦味，我闻得出来。
lines.en: She carries the same bitterness I do; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 这一季只有我们两个在这片浅湾打转。
lines.en: This season only the two of us circle this shallow bay.

lines.zh: 我轻轻碰她的侧腹，用不带毒的那一小块。
lines.en: I nudge her flank with the small patch that carries no venom.

lines.zh: 我们分开游了一圈，又回到同一块石头旁。
lines.en: We part for one lap and return to the same stone.

lines.zh: 她走了，我留在原地，刺又慢慢竖起来。
lines.en: She leaves; I stay, and my spines slowly rise again.

lines.zh: 有东西沉下来，我用嘴顶了顶，它不是食物。
lines.en: Something sinks down; I nudge it with my mouth, and it is not food.

lines.zh: 这块骨头粉是从谁身上磨的，我不问。
lines.en: This bone meal was ground from someone; I do not ask who.

lines.zh: 我把那枚卵石推到你脚边，算是交换。
lines.en: I push that pebble to your feet as a trade.

lines.zh: 水底的东西都归我管，我只捡不吃的。
lines.en: Everything on the seabed is mine to mind; I collect but do not eat.

lines.zh: 一根断刺卡在沙里，那是我的，我叼回来。
lines.en: A broken spine sticks in the sand, mine; I carry it back.

lines.zh: 我咬着那根水草，绕了半圈才肯放下。
lines.en: I hold that seagrass in my mouth and circle halfway before letting go.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西我捡到了，但我不会还给你。
lines.en: I found what you dropped, and I will not be returning it.

lines.zh: 我用刺挑开一块壳，里面什么也没有。
lines.en: I pry open a shell with a spine and find nothing inside.

lines.zh: 沉重的铁块压住沙，我推不动，就算了。
lines.en: A heavy iron piece pins the sand, so I leave it.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞着东西，说话都是气泡。
lines.en: My mouth is full, so my words come out as bubbles.

lines.zh: 你撞了我一下，我现在只看得见你。
lines.en: You bumped me once, and now you are all I can see.

lines.zh: 我锁定你了，别以为游得快就能甩开我。
lines.en: I have you marked; do not think speed will shake me off.

lines.zh: 我的目光很短，但足够盯住你的膝盖。
lines.en: My gaze is short, but it is long enough to hold your knee.

lines.zh: 我不追猎物，我只追刚才撞我的那个。
lines.en: I hunt no prey; I only follow whatever just hit me.

lines.zh: 你身上有我的毒味，我顺着它找你。
lines.en: You carry the smell of my venom, and I follow it to you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，把六根刺一起对准你。
lines.en: I turn slowly and aim all six spines at you at once.

lines.zh: 这个目标不大，可它一直在动。
lines.en: The target is not large, but it will not stop moving.

lines.zh: 我认准了，从今天起这片浅湾不欢迎你。
lines.en: I have decided: this shallow bay is closed to you from today.

lines.zh: 你退到珊瑚后面，我的刺还记着你的方向。
lines.en: You hide behind the coral; my spines still know your direction.

lines.zh: 我锁定的不是你的命，是你的下一次碰撞。
lines.en: What I have marked is not your life but your next collision.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面逼近，刺尖先破开水。
lines.en: I close in along the sand, spine tips parting the water first.

lines.zh: 你每退一格，我就跟一格，不多不少。
lines.en: For every block you retreat, I advance one, no more.

lines.zh: 我看见你的手在抖，水把这消息传得很清楚。
lines.en: I see your hand shake, and the water carries the news clearly.

lines.zh: 我在等你自己撞上来，那比追省力。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to swim into me; it costs less than chasing.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴绷紧了，这是要冲的前兆。
lines.en: My tail is taut; that is the sign I am about to lunge.

lines.zh: 你绕圈，我也绕，我们的圈子越缩越小。
lines.en: You circle, I circle, and the circle keeps tightening.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚踝，那是最容易碰到我的高度。
lines.en: I watch your ankle, the height most likely to reach my spines.

lines.zh: 水流变了，你转身了，我立刻跟上。
lines.en: The current shifts, you turn, and I follow at once.

lines.zh: 我不叫，也不示威，我只是越来越近。
lines.en: I do not call out or display; I only get closer.

lines.zh: 再往前一点，你就又会尝到那十秒。
lines.en: One more block and you will taste those ten seconds again.

lines.zh: 我用头撞你，真正的伤在刺上。
lines.en: I butt you with my head, but the real wound is on the spines.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，重的是它留下的东西。
lines.en: The blow is light; what it leaves behind is not.

lines.zh: 我撞完就退，剩下的交给毒。
lines.en: I strike and withdraw; the venom finishes the work.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡得住撞击，挡不住渗进去的毒。
lines.en: Your armor stops the impact, not the venom seeping in.

lines.zh: 我翻身一刺，动作笨，可刺是尖的。
lines.en: I roll and stab; the move is clumsy, but the spine is sharp.

lines.zh: 别怪我不讲道理，是你先碰我的。
lines.en: Do not call me unfair; you touched me first.

lines.zh: 我打一下要歇很久，五点血经不起折腾。
lines.en: One strike and I rest long; five points cannot afford much.

lines.zh: 你身上多了一个红点，那是我的签名。
lines.en: You have a red dot on you now; that is my signature.

lines.zh: 我咬着你的袖子，刺在你手腕边上晃。
lines.en: I bite your sleeve while a spine sways beside your wrist.

lines.zh: 我这一击是自卫，不是开战。
lines.en: This blow is self-defense, not a war.

lines.zh: 我在暖水里睁开眼，四周全是珊瑚的颜色。
lines.en: I open my eyes in warm water, coral colors on every side.

lines.zh: 出生第一件事，是把六根刺一根根竖起来。
lines.en: My first act at birth is raising all six spines, one by one.

lines.zh: 这片浅湾的水温刚好，我就留在这里了。
lines.en: The bay's water is exactly warm enough, so I stay.

lines.zh: 我一出生就很小，小到能躲进一株海草。
lines.en: I am born small enough to hide inside a single seagrass.

lines.zh: 我身边没有同类，只有一片慢慢摇的暖流。
lines.en: No kin of mine nearby, only a warm current swaying slowly.

lines.zh: 第一次碰到珊瑚，我就学会了怎么疼。
lines.en: The first time I touched coral, I learned what pain is.

lines.zh: 我落在这块沙上，落点比我想的更软。
lines.en: I land on this patch of sand, softer than I expected.

lines.zh: 水面上有光，我不知道那是什么，先躲开。
lines.en: There is light above the surface; I do not know it, so I hide.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有鱼群经过，我不打算加入。
lines.en: A school passes in the distance; I have no plan to join it.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来就开始数刺，数到六才安心。
lines.en: I count my spines the moment I hatch and relax at six.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的鳞，暖水突然变成了烫水。
lines.en: Fire bakes my scales; the warm water has turned scalding.

lines.zh: 我被甩到半空，刺在风里乱转。
lines.en: I am flung into the air, spines spinning in the wind.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的鳃一张一合，什么也吸不到。
lines.en: Out of water my gills open and close and draw nothing.

lines.zh: 气浪把我连刺一起掀翻，我分不清上下。
lines.en: The blast flips me spines and all; I cannot tell up from down.

lines.zh: 箭从上面来，钉穿了我一层薄鳞。
lines.en: The arrow comes from above and pierces my thin scales.

lines.zh: 药水味一散开，我的动作就慢了半拍。
lines.en: The potion smell spreads, and my movements lag half a beat.

lines.zh: 我饿得只剩一层皮，刺显得更长了。
lines.en: Hunger leaves me skin and bones, and my spines look longer.

lines.zh: 雷劈进海里，我整条鱼亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and my whole body lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我的鳃终于白张了。
lines.en: There is no water in the void; at last my gills work for nothing.
